pro_course_detail.title: Sound like a Native with the American English Mouth Posture!
pro_course_detail.description:
READ FIRST: I only accept serious students who will make time outside of class and put in the work required. I will guide you and give you the tools and techniques you need, but your results are mostly dependent on you. This isn't a traditional class where you show up, do a few exercises, and then forget about it until the next lesson.

OUTLINE

We're changing the SETTINGS of how you hold the vocal tract underneath the sounds, meaning that it's less about producing certain sounds (which will also be covered) and more about maintaining the correct settings at all times. That's the main thing that creates the accent, not the sounds.

This course has a few phases:

Phase 0: You'll become aware of your tongue and overall vocal tract, as well as your native posture. If needed, this will include special exercises designed to help you get better control over different parts of the tongue and throat. Phase 0 overlaps with phase 1.


Phase 1: We'll use the House Framework to build the core of the American posture, the foundation for everything else. This includes the schwa/UH/center of gravity. We'll also start working on breathing.


Phase 2: We'll use various techniques and exercises as we go through 2 sections to build the sounds with the posture and slowly start linking things together into syllables, words, and sentences. We'll also add linking, stress, etc as we go, but these are not a main focus in the beginning. 99% of people underestimate the work we're doing and want to jump right to words and sentences, but that's exactly the same as trying to run when you haven't learned to walk.

-SECTION 1 SOUNDS (mostly front):
T/D/N, S/Z, K/G/NG, AW (cot/caught), Y, EE, IH, EH, AH (cat), EI, AI

-SECTION 2 SOUNDS (mostly lips and back): F/V, P/B/M, SH/ZH, CH/J, TH/TH, W, U, O, UUH (book), OW, OI


Phase 3 (new centers of gravity): R (both + R-colored), L (both + L-colored). The R and dark L (mostly) take over the center of gravity and also "color"/blend with various sounds.

pro_course_detail.title: General Pronunciation Lessons (NOT Mouth Posture Course)
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is for anyone who wants to work on their American accent WITHOUT mouth posture. It is NOT possible to have a perfect accent without mouth posture. In addition, the mouth posture approach also makes things easier overall (though it might seem harder in the short term). However, if you just want to sound better/clearer (not perfect or near perfect) and/or you just want to improve certain areas of pronunciation such as stress or linking, then this class is for you. However, I do NOT teach advanced intonation. Basic intonation patterns are fine, but advanced intonation is a tricky topic that I dislike teaching. The exact content we focus on can be tailored to your needs, goals, and interests.

Note that the mouth posture class contains all areas of pronunciation, but things like stress, linking, and rhythm come little by little as we move through the course and are not the main focus, especially in the beginning. Please see the mouth posture course for more information. It is STRONGLY recommended that you at least learn the basic components of mouth posture because it helps everything else, especially the formation and clarity of individual sounds (and will also improve your listening indirectly). We can include these basics in this class if desired.

We can also do any ear training you might need, including hearing the difference between certain sounds, properly hearing the stress, and more.

1-hour classes at least twice a week is recommended, but not required.

Lastly, I do NOT teach beginners. You must have at least a B1/lower-intermediate level. B2/upper-intermediate is preferred. For B1 and B2 students (especially B1), these classes will also drastically improve your listening skills.

I love teaching online as it offers students an efficient way to practice their English skills. I also enjoy learning languages. I speak German well and am conversant in formal and Moroccan Arabic. A such, I understand what it's like to learn a language and understand how important it is to have a patient and supportive teacher.
teacher_info.introduction:
My goals in teaching you English are the following: 1. Communication: Language is a social activity. As such, it is important that you have the means to interact with other human beings using in this case the English language. Therefore, you will practice formally reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Furthermore, you will eventually practice informal and colloquial English so as to better comprehend and communicate with native English speakers from the United States. 2. Participation: You will be the one using the English language during our sessions. My job is to prepare the lesson for you and your job is to be ready and willing to use English. I will not judge you but I will help you to improve your English language skills through repetition and your active participation; in fact, having learned language myself here on Italki, I understand how important it is for you to have a patient and supportive teacher. 3. Cultural Immersion: I believe that language exists in a cultural context. For those of you who are interested, I will provide you with contemporary media meant to teach you the English language in a north American context. Moreover, I can provide you with suitable literature to examine, too.

My promises to you: 1. During our first lesson, I will evaluate your English level. I will plan your lessons accordingly so that they are not too difficult, but at the same time will challenge you enough that your English will improve. 2. I will prepare each and every lesson for you beforehand. Each lesson will have a particular outcome in mind. 3. I will adapt our lessons to your particular goals. Are you preparing for an English language exam? Or are you planning to travel or to undertake business in an English- speaking country? In both cases the lessons I will plan will be different. 4. I cannot promise that you will become fluent in only a few months, but I can promise you that your English will improve steadily with your hard work.

pro_course_detail.title: Guided English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description: Do you wish to learn how to become more fluent in your English speech and eventually how to sound more like a native speaker?  In this course you practice and improve your fluency and pronunciation by examining in detail those elements of English, such as intonation and stress, which make native speakers sound the way they do.  You will learn to use the international phonetic alphabet as well. This course is for beginning to advanced students.

pro_course_detail.title: English (Reading, Writing, Listening, Speaking)
pro_course_detail.description: In this course you practice all four language skills. You have the option of using a textbook or, if you prefer, I can provide you with custom lessons. In either case, I provide you with supplementary materials such as YouTube clips, podcasts, articles, and book excerpts. This course is for beginning to advanced students.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate and Advanced English Through Literature
pro_course_detail.description: In this course you examine some of the American and English literary classics as a means to be introduced to and to unfold some of the more complex structural aspects of the English language. You also become better grounded in the cultural and historical nuances of English.

pro_course_detail.title: Informal Tutoring
pro_course_detail.description: In this class you bring any questions that you have about the English language to class and we will use these questions as the basis for a lesson. Moreover, for students looking for informal conversation practice, this would be the correct class to choose.

pro_course_detail.title: NEW COURSE Academic English: Writing and Presentations
pro_course_detail.description: In this course we will focus on English as it is used in an academic environment. In particular, we will work on academic writing and presentations. I will show you how to construct papers and presentations that are both informative and persuasive. Finally, we will also practice listening to and understanding lectures and presentations. This is an intensive course. There is required homework. Please contact me if you would like more information about this course.
